findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：專利和解（允許 Remodulin、Tyvaso 霧化、Orenitram 學名藥上市）可能引發 FTC 或私人反壟斷主張；公司遭 Sandoz 控違反和解協議，已提列 7,410 萬美元負債。
findings.excerpt: In some instances, the FTC has brought actions against brand and generic companies that have entered into such agreements, alleging that they violate antitrust laws. Even in the absence of an FTC challenge, other governmental or private litigants may assert antitrust or other claims against us relating to such agreements.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司曾遭 DOJ 調查其對非營利病患援助計畫的捐助，並被 Humana、UnitedHealth、MSP Recovery 以 RICO 等提告。
findings.excerpt: We have been, and may in the future, be subject to DOJ investigations with respect to our support of non-profit patient assistance programs, which can result in sanctions, fines, or other payments and agreements with respect to our compliance programs.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見 2026 年 FTC／DOJ 針對 UTHR 的新反壟斷調查；搜尋摘要稱第三巡迴上訴法院維持駁回 Sandoz 對 Remodulin 的反壟斷主張（日期未核）。
